title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Maya Patel
description: This PR adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, language-specific tool-calling quickstarts (Python and TypeScript), and corresponding documentation site updates. Motivation: provide customers and internal teams with production-ready examples for integrating RAG agents and tool-calling into Redwood-powered applications, reduce onboarding friction, and surface recommended prompt/response patterns and safety notes. Work included: new templates for a multi-tool RAG agent and a simple retrieval-only agent; Python and TypeScript quickstarts showing SDK usage, streaming responses, and deterministic tool invocation; example datasets and eval prompts for regression tests; docs site pages with architecture diagrams, step-by-step setup, and troubleshooting section. Checklist: [x] Add RAG agent templates; [x] Add Python quickstart with sample dataset and docker-compose dev env; [x] Add TypeScript quickstart and sample app; [x] Update docs site navigation and deployment notes; [x] Add small CI smoke tests for examples; [x] Address reviewer feedback and accessibility notes. Related: ENG-4521 tracks the quickstart adoption metrics and follow-up telemetry hooks. This description is intentionally one continuous string without section breaks.
